title: 2026 Report: Student Affiliates of Seventeen (SAS)
abstract: The Student Affiliates of Seventeen (SAS) annual report represents the accomplishments of several boards and committees, made up of students across the country. As they combine their efforts to engage a larger body of counseling psychology students with academic enrichment, collaboration, and professional development. The following report represents works completed during the 2025-2026 academic year centering American Psychological Association (APA) values of flexibility and adaptability, advocacy, and recognition of maintaining hope during sociopolitical challenging periods.
